content:
deploy-bot: Starting multi-service deploy (fanout) to prod-us-west1
- tag: release-2026-03-20
- services: runtime@v1.8.2 (sha: a1b2c3d), api@v2.4.0 (sha: d4e5f6g), console@v3.1.0 (sha: z9y8x7w)
- plan: canary sequence runtime -> api -> console, 5m stagger, fallback: automatic rollback to previous stable if healthchecks fail

jess: ack. i'm on watch. change window until 18:00 PT.

miguel: runtime canaries will run on g5-16 pools. pinned kernel flag enabled for this rollout.

sam: FYI i merged the batching tweak for api (increase default batch_size from 8 -> 12) — that was in the v2.4.0 tag.

deploy-bot: runtime canary started: 3 replicas (r1,r2,r3)

deploy-bot: runtime canary healthy 3/3 after 2m 12s :white_check_mark:

mitra: seeing small CPU bump on runtime r2 but within expected, looks fine.

deploy-bot: starting api canary: 5 replicas (a1..a5)

caroline: adding tracing hook, will dump traces into #eng-sre if anything odd.

deploy-bot: api canary healthcheck failing on 2/5 replicas (a3,a4) — status: 502 responses

mitra: investigating; grabbing logs https://tracing.prod/redwood/trace/abc123

sam: rolling back the batching tweak; will push config rollback to canary group.

deploy-bot: api canary rollback in progress -> reverting to api@v2.3.9 (sha: c7b6a5f)

deploy-bot: api rollback complete. post-rollback health: 5/5 healthy :white_check_mark:

jess: good call. pinning api to v2.3.9 for this release. updating release notes to note config change caused 502s.

deploy-bot: console deployment skipped due to api rollback dependency; console requires api >= v2.4.0

alek: will notify PMs and affected customers in change window. sending update to status page.

jess: action item: open follow-up to investigate batching tweak interactions with proxy. assigning to @sam and @mitra.

sam: got it, i'll dig in and propose a safer rollout (gradual flag + perf gate).

deploy-bot: final fanout status snapshot:
- runtime: deployed runtime@v1.8.2 (sha: a1b2c3d) — success
- api: rolled back to api@v2.3.9 (sha: c7b6a5f) — automated rollback triggered
- console: aborted (dependency on api@v2.4.0)

caroline: filing incident note for postmortem. tagging oncall.

jess: marking this release as partial; will re-run console + api after fix. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: thread closed at 1825023580. logs: s3://redwood-deploys/prod/1825023456/*.log
